caveats: Not physically qualified: the frozen e3final runtime API (load_policy_fn, exe(state, with_lanes=True), executor memory/dwell .present, leverprobe Backend attributes) is taken from the A/B/R path that already uses it (coopfree.backend.tick, coopnative Comparator); dry does not load the executor or touch SUMO, so the first real test is the u24 run itself
Fail-closed like the A/B/R harness: any collision/teleport/dropped step stops that episode; any failed job writes LANEON_u024_FAILED.json, charges stay recorded and the command refuses to retry
launch_training.health() gates waiting and dispatch: a durable STOP/FAULT/PAUSE_SAFETY in the root blocks the baseline (it never writes STOP/FAULT itself)
